issues.description: Payment token stored in plain text in logs and database - exposes PCI-DSS compliance violation
issues.suggestion: Never log sensitive payment data. Use PCI-compliant tokenization and store only token references

issues.description: Missing validation of payment webhook signatures - allows unauthorized subscription changes
